entities.summary: Karim Mojtahedi was an Iranian philosophy professor at Tehran University. He published over 20 books on philosophy. He was awarded UNESCO's Avicenna Prize for Ethics in Science at the 4th International Farabi Festival and received a plaque of honor from Iran's Cultural Luminaries Association. Born on 1 September 1930, Mojtahedi died on 15 January 2024, at the age of 93.
